description: after($x) of the chosen a is the original suffix, which is empty, so the synthetic T after A cannot make the lookahead true. a survives with c, which reads the synthetic as a bare T (engine §7.5).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%elidable T
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a $x(A) [T]
%conditions ¬begins(after($x), t)
%rule b A [T] [T]
%rule c A T
%rule t T
